extracted.name: Steak & Bean Salad
extracted.description: Try a twist on the classic salad with sirloin steak in place of tuna for a filling and balanced midweek meal that take just 30 minutes to make
ingredient_lines: 24 cherry tomatoes, halves or regular tomato, cubed
1/2 cup Parsley, finely chopped or Basil
14 ounces (400 g) sirloin steak, trimmed of all fat
3 tablespoons chili paste or paprika according to your desired taste
instruction_lines: Toss the garbanzo beans, onion, tomatoes and parsley in an salad bowl
Season steak generously with salt and pepper. Preheat a grill pan on high heat. Grill the steak until cooked to your liking, 5-10minutes for medium rare. Set aside. Slightly roast the green beans.
Whisk the yogurt with the chili paste in a small bowl. Slice the steak and add to the salad bowl. Drizzle with the yogurt mixture, toss gently and serve.
